source_method.source_selection: All143 consumed AI-containing connected groups; hash-first AI source, same-group human if available, otherwise one unused hash-ordered genuine-only group. No authenticity score selection.
source_method.roles_rule: Stratify by selected AI generator; salted hash order and globally continuing round-robin roles. All originals, speaker/transcript ancestry and backgrounds remain role-disjoint.
source_method.backgrounds: All48 consumed licensed originals, disjoint canonical identities; hash-partition each kind into four roles; pair-hash choice and deterministic four-second offset within its role. Reused nuisance parents within a role are disclosed.
source_method.render: Normalize both foreground prefixes separately to RMS0.1; add the same selected human/noise/music background to the second half at -5 or5dB; one peak-safe gain shared by all patterns/conditions of a pair; canonical mono16kHz s16 WAV roundtrip.
source_method.source_truth: Any overlap of a planned4s window with a known AI foreground interval. Background speech is genuine. Ordinary edits/looping, noise and speaker changes alone are not AI truth.
source_method.windows: Full-profile production0,2,4s windows on8s input; original full-clip Silero gate; every planned window retained, including gated-out evidence.
source_method.band: Whole-clip zero-phase Butterworth100–3800Hz/order4; same source windows/gate; never treated as a second truth or a recovered original.
source_method.routing: Original-window measured normalized spectral-flatness>=0.65: diffuse; otherwise concentrated. Generator, known SNR, recipe, label and model response are excluded from routing.
source_method.calibration: Four source-disjoint roles; full-view pooled/context and full+band pooled/context arms. One dependence family; maximum positive calibrated logit, separately fitted/calibrated file result. L2=.001;50:50 reference prior.
source_method.operating_comparison: Internal AI-only point on fusion_cal genuine foreground-pair maxima: strict greater than nearest-rank ceil((n+1)*.9), capped at n. All arm artifacts/points frozen before confirmation authenticity inference. No customer threshold or error guarantee.
source_method.quality_gates: Against pooled full-view research reference: more AI files found, no additional false-AI foreground groups, no coverage loss, lower source/class-balanced Brier. Per-condition/local errors and all inconclusive denominators retained; no automatic admission.
source_method.native_audit: Exact publisher assets; retained exact old WAV/PCM/raw parity before new authenticity inference; first window per role/view/context direct repeat; source/native coordinates audited separately.
source_method.limits: Consumed foregrounds/backgrounds, unknown external model-training overlap and artificial splice boundaries.35/36 foreground-pair groups per role are not independent background recordings; each role has6 noise/3music/3speech parents. No background-authenticity, unseen-customer, fresh-independent or court claim.

policy.operating_scope: Genuine foreground-pair maxima of assessed fusion_cal files; unassessed files/groups explicitly counted, no response imputation. Strict greater than upper nearest rank ceil((n+1)*.9), capped at n.
policy.admission: No serving admission; continuation only. Consumed sources, limited independent background parents and external pretraining overlap require new independent-source validation.

source_role: Consumed-source development; no new authenticity-model forward at freeze.
